scope: 跨项目本地复核与数据库对照；verified 仅指所述检查，不是新发现、独立实验或外部认证。

items.title: 稀疏动力学已知答案复核
items.scientificClaim: 本机 PySINDy 能从合成轨迹近似恢复预设线性系数。
items.limitations: 仅验证本机指定版本能恢复已知线性系统，不是新规律发现。
items.upstreamContribution: 提供固定特征库和显式误差边界的可重放基线。

items.title: 实数约束已知答案复核
items.scientificClaim: 两个预设实数约束均被 Z3 判定为不可满足。
items.limitations: 验证两个实数约束的已知答案，不等同一般数学定理的自动证明。
items.upstreamContribution: 为形式化前的反例搜索提供最小可执行样例。

items.title: 乙酰唑胺跨库属性审计
items.scientificClaim: 规范结构、分子式和精确质量一致；描述符差异必须连算法口径一起解释。
items.limitations: 规范结构、分子式和精确质量与 PubChem 快照一致；TPSA 计入 S/P 后按整数口径一致；XLogP 算法差异单独保留。这不是实验验证，也不据此指认数据造假。
items.upstreamContribution: 提供结构归一、S/P 口径、算法差异和精度的公开对照样例。

items.title: 硅结构派生量独立重算
items.scientificClaim: 从同一公开晶体结构本地重算的密度和空间群与 Materials Project 快照一致。
items.limitations: 本地从公开结构独立重算密度与空间群并核对；带隙和稳定性仅为外部 DFT 快照，未在本机重算。
items.upstreamContribution: 提供规范 ID 迁移、结构快照与本地派生量核对的轻量复现包。

items.title: 血红蛋白结构—序列跨库桥接
items.scientificClaim: P68871 去除起始甲硫氨酸后与 4HHB entity 2 的 146 aa 序列逐字符一致。
items.limitations: 验证实验结构实体与 reviewed 序列记录的对应关系，不是蛋白功能、机制或临床结论。
items.upstreamContribution: 提供不依赖截断字段、由基因/物种检索到精确序列验证的跨库桥接。

items.title: 乙酰唑胺—CA II—实验结构链

metrics.selectivityIndependence: 同一文档、同一 record_id；三条记录不是独立重复实验

items.scientificClaim: 乙酰唑胺的化合物标识、CA II 策划机制、P00918/3HS4 的 260 aa 精确序列、单一 Ki 测定和实验复合物可以逐层追溯；同方法 CA I/II 表观比值单独分析，跨文档固定常数不成立；2H4N 只作不同构建的结构对照。
items.limitations: 化合物 InChIKey、CA II 靶点、P00918/3HS4 entity 1 的 260 aa 精确序列、单一活性记录和实验复合物已核对；Ki=12 nM 只属于 assay CHEMBL657848。potential_duplicate=1 保留为审计警告，不据此直接判造假，也不外推临床效力。 CA I/II 的 250/12=20.8333 是同一文档、同一酯酶方法下的表观 Ki 比值，提示而非证明普遍选择性；无重复实验统计、置信区间或临床外推。CA IX 因方法不同仅单列。potential_duplicate=1 全部保留。 六组文档的表观 Ki 比值从 20.8333 到 75，极差倍数为 3.6；仅一组明确同酯酶方法，其余方法信息不足，不能据此合并成普适选择性常数。不同文档和重复标记也不保证实验独立。 2H4N 与 3HS4 是不同构建的实验结构对照，不能当作同一野生型复合物的独立重复；序列字符串长度 260 与元数据 259 不一致，需进一步核对原始 mmCIF。未比较坐标或结合几何，也不据此证明 Ki 重复。
items.upstreamContribution: 提供 InChIKey、靶点全长序列、assay、配体实体、重复标记、方法一致定量对照、跨文档负结果和不同构建结构对照完整保留的药物—靶点—结构审计链。

items.title: Chwirut 高距离真实数据留出
items.scientificClaim: 三参数模型在预注册高距离切片获得有限支持；NIST 全数据认证复现与留出预测证据严格分开。
items.limitations: One contiguous high-distance split on one NIST dataset; not random cross-validation or a universal model-family test No independent ultrasonic measurements, measurement-covariance estimate or new physical mechanism was produced NIST certified values are used only for known-answer reproduction, never as holdout evidence The seven holdout observations were not used for fitting, start selection, model selection or threshold retuning
items.upstreamContribution: 提供原始数据哈希、冻结留出协议、双起点拟合、两项基线和54点独立复算。

items.title: Z3 定义域与参数可识别性反例

checks.claim: If b2>0, b3>=0 and x>=0, then b2+b3*x>0
checks.interpretation: The negated implication is unsatisfiable within this explicit domain

checks.claim: The model remains defined without denominator constraints
checks.interpretation: A zero denominator is reachable without sign restrictions; the claim is falsified

checks.claim: An x=0 response alone uniquely identifies all three parameters
checks.interpretation: Two distinct parameter triples produce the same x=0 response; identifiability depends on experimental design

items.scientificClaim: 显式正性域内分母恒正；无分母约束存在反例，x=0 单点不能唯一识别全部参数。
items.limitations: These are finite-domain satisfiability checks and explicit counterexamples, not a general proof of the Chwirut model or of all nonlinear systems The x=0 calculation is algebraically simplified before using Z3; no nonlinear exponential solver is claimed Counterexamples falsify the stated universal claims only; they do not invalidate the NIST dataset or the fitted model within its valid domain
items.upstreamContribution: 提供可重放的有限域证明义务、显式反例和实验设计可识别性边界。

items.title: 阿司匹林跨库身份与描述符口径审计
items.scientificClaim: 阿司匹林在 PubChem、ChEMBL 与 RDKit 间结构身份一致；LogP、氢键和可旋转键定义差异不构成造假证据。
items.limitations: This is a public-record identity and algorithm audit, not a wet-lab experiment, bioactivity meta-analysis or clinical conclusion Identical identity and selected descriptors do not imply every database field uses the same algorithm No activity value is merged or inferred from the structural match Descriptor differences are not labeled as data fabrication; provenance, units and conventions must be examined first
items.upstreamContribution: 提供 CID/CHEMBL/InChIKey 对照、结构归一、精确质量和多口径描述符审计。

items.title: MP／OQMD／PyMatGen 三组材料结构复核
items.scientificClaim: Si、GaAs、SiO2 的跨库结构身份分别成立，但 DFT 带隙、密度和稳定性不因此被强制相等。
items.limitations: Three paired structures are a methods demonstration, not a global DFT accuracy benchmark or new material discovery Band gaps and stability fields come from different DFT workflows and convex-hull references; they are not forced equal Local density is recomputed from OQMD structures; MP density may correspond to another structure snapshot or setting No independent experiment, experimental band gap or universal ranking of DFT implementations is claimed
items.upstreamContribution: 提供原生 entry_id 与 OPTIMADE ID 的显式映射、完整结构快照和独立密度/空间群重算。

items.title: Eckerle4 双尾真实数据外推
items.scientificClaim: 三参数高斯在独立 Eckerle4 的预注册双尾任务获得有限支持；全数据认证复现与双尾外推严格分开。
items.limitations: One two-tail split on one independent NIST dataset; not random cross-validation or a universal Gaussian-family test No independent transmittance measurements, measurement-covariance estimate or new physical mechanism was produced NIST certified values are used only for known-answer reproduction, never as holdout evidence All eight tail observations were excluded from fitting, start selection, model selection and threshold retuning
items.upstreamContribution: 提供第二独立数据集、双尾协议、中央拟合、两项基线和35点独立复算。

items.title: cvc5／Z3 交叉求解器复核
items.scientificClaim: cvc5 与 Z3 对分母正性、零分母反例和 x=0 参数非识别性给出相同结果，并生成精确有理数反例模型。
items.limitations: Three finite SMT-LIB checks are cross-solver reproductions, not general nonlinear theorem proving The x=0 response is algebraically simplified before using either solver; no nonlinear exponential solver is claimed Agreement between two solvers increases implementation confidence only within the explicit formulas and domains
items.upstreamContribution: 提供双求解器 SMT-LIB、原始日志、官方二进制哈希和精确模型，降低单求解器依赖。

items.title: Hahn1 有理模型高温外推与分母边界
items.scientificClaim: 七参数有理模型在预注册高温切片获得有限支持并优于三次多项式基线；分母在实验区间内无零根，但存在域外正根。
items.limitations: One high-temperature split on one NIST dataset; not random cross-validation or a universal rational-family test No independent thermal-expansion measurements, measurement-covariance estimate or new physical mechanism was produced NIST certified values are used only for known-answer reproduction, never as holdout evidence The 17 highest-temperature observations were not used for fitting, start selection, model selection or threshold retuning Seven coefficients are not automatically physically endogenous; denominator roots and multiple minima must be reviewed separately The certified denominator has no zero root within 0<=x<=900, but a positive root exists beyond the experimental range; no positivity claim is made for every parameter triple or all x>=0
items.upstreamContribution: 提供有理模型、强基线、236点预测复算和双求解器分母边界审计。

items.title: 跨数据集连续区间压力测试与失效定位
items.scientificClaim: Chwirut 和 Eckerle4 五折均不劣于基线；Hahn1 第 1 折显著失效，因此整体不能称为稳健支持。
items.limitations: Five contiguous grouped folds per dataset are stress diagnostics, not universal model-family rankings or independent experiments Contiguous folds include interpolation and extrapolation regimes; a good median cannot hide a failing interval Optimizer failures and non-finite predictions are failures, not missing successes Parameters fitted on four groups are never selected using the held-out group
items.upstreamContribution: 提供15折连续区间压力诊断、全部失败区间、基线对照和防泄漏协议。

items.title: Hahn1 第 1 折局部可识别性与双极点诊断
items.scientificClaim: 五折均为数值满秩；第 1 折在约 45.526978 K 和 72.131671 K 有两个留出区数值单极点，近根位置出现巨大预测与残差，支持局部失效机制解释。
items.limitations: This is post-hoc diagnosis after observing fold 1 failure, not preregistered or independent validation Local Jacobians, covariances and delta-method sensitivities do not prove global structural identifiability or calibrated uncertainty Column-normalized condition numbers reduce unit-scale dominance but do not remove nonlinear parameter compensation A nonzero denominator excludes isolated poles only at evaluated points and does not guarantee stable extrapolation No new physical experiment, model revision or parameter-endogeneity claim is produced Numerical roots and residuals are not exact algebraic certificates A simple-pole diagnosis requires the reported nonzero numerator and derivative at the numerical root; no removable singularity is assumed The earlier certified full-fit denominator proof applies to different coefficients and cannot be transferred to these fold fits Root localization is post-hoc mechanism evidence and does not make the failed fold successful
items.upstreamContribution: 提供逐折解析雅可比、局部敏感度、数值根及根处分子和导数，形成预测区极点排除与可识别性验收义务。

items.title: Thurber 预测区与可识别性数据集前瞻验收
items.scientificClaim: Thurber 全数据拟合通过 NIST 已知答案复核；第 2—5 折通过冻结验收，第 1 折在约 -3.019661 的留出区实根处失效，因此整体五折支持不成立。
items.limitations: One additional NIST dataset is a dataset-prospective computational check, not an independent physical experiment Numerical root and dense-grid checks cover each closed held-out interval, not every mathematically possible point outside it Full numerical rank and finite local standard errors do not prove global structural identifiability or physically meaningful parameters No model, start, fold or threshold was retuned after seeing Thurber outcomes NIST certified values are used only for known-answer implementation reproduction, never as held-out evidence
items.upstreamContribution: 提供新数据集冻结协议、全部五折预测区根检查、局部秩与协方差检查、三次基线和失败记录。

items.title: Kirby2 二次有理模型跨次数前瞻验收
items.scientificClaim: Kirby2 五折均无留出区实根、数值秩均为 5 且均优于二次基线，因此获得本协议下整体有限支持；第 1 折外推衰减和高条件数仍保留。
items.limitations: One quadratic/quadratic NIST dataset is a dataset-prospective computational check, not an independent physical experiment Numerical roots and dense-grid checks cover each closed held-out interval only Full numerical rank and finite local standard errors do not prove global structural identifiability or physical endogeneity No model, start, fold or threshold was retuned after seeing Kirby2 outcomes NIST certified values are used only for known-answer implementation reproduction, never as held-out evidence
items.upstreamContribution: 提供不同次数有理模型的阳性对照、全部五折根检查、局部数值诊断、二次基线和训练—留出衰减对照。

items.title: 有理模型统一内核与跨数据集综合

metrics.interpretation: Counts summarize these fifteen folds only and are not sensitivity, specificity or universal detection-accuracy estimates

items.scientificClaim: 统一内核下 15 折中 13 折符合验收；Hahn1 和 Thurber 各有一个预测区失败折，Kirby2 五折均通过。计数不表示普适检出率。
items.limitations: Hahn1 folds are post-hoc gate reconstructions; Thurber and Kirby2 retain their dataset-prospective labels Three NIST datasets and fifteen folds cannot establish universal detection accuracy or a model-family ranking Numerical roots and dense-grid checks do not constitute exact global algebraic certificates Local full rank and finite positive standard errors do not prove global structural identifiability or physical endogeneity No new fitting, physical experiment or external collaboration was performed for this synthesis
items.upstreamContribution: 提供统一雅可比、数值根、预测区和局部数值诊断接口，并区分事后重建与数据集前瞻证据。

items.title: 精确 Sturm 区间根隔离与双求解器复核
items.scientificClaim: 对十五折有理系数快照，13 个闭区间精确无根，Hahn1 第 1 折精确有 2 根，Thurber 第 1 折精确有 1 根；双求解器逐折一致。
items.limitations: Exact results concern the JSON decimal rational coefficient snapshots, not exact physical parameters or exact binary floating-point values Sturm isolation proves distinct real-root counts within each specified closed interval only Solver sat models are consistency witnesses, not exact algebraic root forms; Sturm intervals are the root-existence evidence No claim is made outside the specified intervals or for perturbed coefficients The two solver checks increase implementation confidence but do not replace the exact Sturm computation or independent review
items.upstreamContribution: 提供精确 Sturm 隔离、十五份 SMT-LIB、三十份求解器日志及完整哈希，区分快照证明与物理参数精确性。

items.title: 连续参数盒无根稳定性证明

totals.interpretation: Counts report exact sufficient certificates for these frozen folds, not necessary radii or confidence coverage

items.scientificClaim: 13 个无根快照均获得正的连续参数盒无根半径；11 折达到上限 4，Hahn1 第 5 折和 Thurber 第 2 折为有限半径括号。
items.limitations: The radius is a sufficient certificate for the stated coefficient box, not a necessary maximum or a statistical confidence region Local linearized standard errors are only scales; they do not create a probability distribution or independent physical uncertainty estimate The proof covers simultaneous coefficient perturbations inside the certified box and the specified closed x interval only The uncertified upper bracket is not called unsafe; cap-hit results may permit larger boxes Rooted snapshots cannot have a root-free neighborhood; this does not predict how their roots move
items.upstreamContribution: 提供连续参数区域的精确充分性证明和跨零分段协议，不把下界当作置信区或必要最大半径。

items.title: 认证参数盒内逐点预测与残差上界
items.scientificClaim: 13 折共 369 个留出观测获得确定性预测平移与残差上界；无根盒并不保证有用的预测精度，极大有限上界明确保留。
items.limitations: Bounds are deterministic and conservative for every denominator in each certified box at the supplied observation points Numerator coefficients remain fixed; numerator and model-structure errors are outside this bound No probabilistic interval, RMSE bound, calibration, continuous-x error bound or physical measurement uncertainty is claimed Rooted snapshots and cases without a positive denominator certificate do not receive this bound Large finite upper bounds remain valid bounds but may be uninformative for practical prediction
items.upstreamContribution: 提供逐点精确有理上界和分母下界，区分定义域安全、预测界宽度和实际预测信息。

items.title: 协方差椭球与独立参数盒逐点比较
items.scientificClaim: 同一半径下 369 个适用点的协方差椭球上界全部小于独立盒；中位比值 0.604836，最大 0.999351，两个有根折不适用。
items.limitations: The covariance defines a deterministic ellipsoid only; no probability, confidence or physical measurement model is implied Bounds are pointwise and do not prove root freedom for an ellipsoid over a continuous x interval Numerator perturbation and model-structure error are outside the comparison An unavailable ellipsoid bound is not zero and no preferred tighter direction is assumed Rational square-root upper bounds may be conservative and all ratio classes are preserved
items.upstreamContribution: 提供完整协方差方向、精确支撑上界和逐点比值，明确盒与椭球是不同区域，不把样本收紧称为永远更紧。
